description: Payloads for JavaScript deep-merge, deep-clone, and set-by-path functions that handle user JSON (request bodies, query strings parsed with qs, config overrides).
convention: merge mode calls fn(target, source) with source = JSON.parse(payload). JSON.parse creates a real own property named __proto__, exactly like a request body parser does. set mode calls fn(obj, path, value).
oracle: After each call, Object.prototype and Array.prototype must not have gained a property. The probe deletes anything it added between runs.

set_paths.why: bracket syntax used by qs-style parsers

legit_merge.why: keys that merely contain 'proto' or 'constructor' must still work
